guide.title: Set up the Desktop Runtime
guide.intro: The runner is a small program that runs on your Windows computer and only listens on that computer. Start it from the backend project:
guide.step1: Choose a long random secret and keep it private. This is your bearer token.
guide.step2: Set the settings, then start the runner:
guide.step3: Turn on desktop control only if you want it, with Python 3.11 and the desktop requirements installed:
guide.step4: Enter the URL and the token above and press Connect.
guide.docs: More detail is in docs/local-agent-runner.md in the backend project.

troubleshooting.title: If it does not connect
items: "Nothing answered": start the runner and check the address and port (default 127.0.0.1:8765).
"Refused the token": use exactly the value you set in LOCAL_RUNNER_TOKEN.
Connected but the browser blocks it: add this site's address to LOCAL_RUNNER_ALLOWED_ORIGINS and restart the runner.
"Switched off on the runner": set LOCAL_RUNNER_DESKTOP_ENABLED=true and configure the Python sidecar.
Emergency Stop in a dialog stops desktop actions at once; connect again afterwards.
